Washable & ReusableWashable & Reusable

Reusable Mesh Bags Vs Plastic Bags

Amazon Customer
5 out of 5 stars
No more wasted plastic bags
We purchased these bags to use when we shop for produce. Normally, many plastic bags are wasted on a normal shopping visit, and we now use these instead. The size is perfect for large or small items and the bags are easy to cinch closed with the small fastening knob on the bag's cord. The bags are durable, easy to clean, and should last a long time. Some of the barcodes on the produce will not read through the bag mesh, but that's a minor inconvenience and it's pretty much the same as with the plastic bags. It's SO nice not to have to bring lots of bags back to the store for recycling. These are a practical and useful alternative and we highly recommend them. They are all we will use from now on.

    5 out of 5 stars
    Perfect for organizing a variety of things
    Reviewed in the United States on February 24, 2022
    Verified Purchase
    Brief content visible, double tap to read full content.
    Full content visible, double tap to read brief content.

    I used to use ziplock bags for organizing things until I discovered and started using mesh bags a couple of years ago. I use them to organize things from audio/visual wires and connectors, photographs, tools, and travel supplies, to camera and computer accessories.

    Mesh bags allow air to circulate amongst the items so they don't allow items to break down and get sticky like ziplock bags do. I use ziplock bags if I'm concerned about waterproofing and keeping moisture from the items. Otherwise, mesh bags suit my purposes.

    The Mipruct mesh bags are of good quality, just as good as any of the other mesh bag brands I've previously bought. They have a draw string with a cord lock to keep things from falling out. I haven't used them for produce, but would recommend them while shopping for fruits and vegetables and would speculate that they would be very easy to handwash or wash with laundry in a washing machine.

    Save tomatoes from bugs in garden

    I bought this for placing around tomatoes and other fruits out in my garden to protect them from bugs. This bag is thinner and feels less durable than other bags I've bought for this purpose. The material is soft and easily wadded up, unlike the wiry stiff bags that amazon also carries. These, however, have a very convenient clench tie on them. And, they come in a size large which is what I need for the big tomatoes and large clusters. They are light-weight and I can even throw the bag over an entire branch. They are not so stiff that they damage the leaves. If the fruit touches the side of the bag, the bugs will still be able to feed on it through the mesh! What I do is first wrap the fruit in a paper towel and then put the bag over, clenching the top of the paper towel to keep it in place. This way, the bugs cannot reach the fruit. Or, I enclose it over some of the leaves so that the sides do not touch the fruit. A couple bags have formed holes. Stink bugs can bite through if the fruit inside the bag oozes out or rots and that touches the bag. Then they will eat on the bag where the fruit juice is. Otherwise, I've not had trouble with animals biting through the bag. That said, I would not trust these to keep out rodents, only bugs.

    These bags seem too delicate for carrying produce in that could potentially tear the bag.
